digest.component_or_area: reconciler transport parameter typing and mypy enforcement
propositions: Core reconciler transport parameters annotated via absolute shim import (rebar_reconciler._backend) are silently widened to Any by mypy due to ignore_missing_imports, making annotations unenforceable despite appearing correct in review.
Relative imports within the reconciler package resolve correctly to the true TicketTransport type, enabling mypy attribute-checking and enforcement of port contract completeness.

Mypy detects opt-in capability members (add_comment, set_relationship) as [attr-defined] errors when called on port-typed parameters, a class of defect the existing hasattr-based AST audit structurally cannot report.
The custom _TransportPortMeta metaclass does not disable mypy attribute-checking; the blindness observed in earlier probes was caused by unresolvable import paths, not the metaclass itself.

All 38 port parameters in the core reconciler must be annotated with TicketTransport (or a composed capability Protocol) via relative imports, with capability calls narrowed to composed views using cast, to enable static enforcement of port contract completeness.
